fact: PMI Measure Malaria states that health centres collect and report health data on paper tools and still have no access to the information in DHIS2, for want of computers, internet and reliable electricity, and that mobile dashboard applications drawing on DHIS2 were put into 20 ESPC from March 2022 and 16 more in October 2022; these display data and are not data entry.
title: Amélioration de la qualité et de l'utilisation des données sur le paludisme en Côte d'Ivoire pour la prise de décision
